title: Python code gets type checks and a bug lint in the gate
what: Add a type checker (mypy, pinned, run through uv) and ruff's pyflakes rules (F) to the free gate as one step, configured in one pyproject.toml; annotate the code gradually, module by module, strict for every module that is fully annotated; records read by several scripts get TypedDict/dataclass types.
why: Owner, verbatim: "добавь эти проверки типов в python". Today 0 of 371 functions in lib/ carry type hints, and ruff's pyflakes rules find 14 real defects (unused imports and variables, redefined names); today's bugs were mostly a value of the wrong shape passed between modules (a test name form, a transcript entry kind).
